entry.name: fluid.bufampgate~
entry.description: Absolute amplitude threshold gate detector on audio in a buffer

arguments.name: maxsize
arguments.description: The amount of memory allocated at instantiation. It limits how other parameters can be modulated:,, andshould not exceed. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: highpassfreq
attributes.digest: High-Pass Filter Cutoff
attributes.description: The frequency of the fourth-order Linkwitz-Riley high-pass filter () applied to the signal to minimise low frequency intermodulation with very short ramp lengths. A frequency of 0 bypasses the filter. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: indices
attributes.digest: Indices Buffer
attributes.description: The buffer to write the gate information into. Buffer will be resized appropriately so that each frame contains an onset (opening) position on channel 0 and the corresponding offset (closing) position on channel 1 (both in samples). The buffer will have as many frames as gate events detected.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: lookahead
attributes.digest: Forward Lookup Length
attributes.description: When an offset is detected, the algorithm will wait this duration (in samples) to find a minimum in the envelope follower to identify as the offset point. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: lookback
attributes.digest: Backward Lookup Length
attributes.description: When an onset is detected, the algorithm will look in the recent past (this length in samples) for a minimum in the envelope follower to identify as the onset point. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: minlengthabove
attributes.digest: Required Minimum Length Above Threshold
attributes.description: The length in samples that the envelope must be above the threshold to consider it a valid onset. The onset will be triggered at the first sample when the condition is met. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: minlengthbelow
attributes.digest: Required Minimum Length Below Threshold
attributes.description: The length in samples that the envelope must be below the threshold to consider it a valid offset. The offset will be triggered at the first sample when the condition is met. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: minsilencelength
attributes.digest: Minimum Length of Silence
attributes.description: The minimum length in samples for which the gate will stay closed. Changes of states during that period after an offset will be ignored. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: minslicelength
attributes.digest: Minimum Length of Slice
attributes.description: The minimum length in samples for which the gate will stay open. Changes of states during this period after an onset will be ignored. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: numchans
attributes.digest: Number of Channels
attributes.description: For multichannel sources, how many channels should be included in the analysis (starting from). The default of -1 indicates to include all the channels fromthrough the rest of the buffer. If more than one channel is specified, the channels will be summed to mono for analysis.

attributes.name: numframes
attributes.digest: Number of Frames
attributes.description: How many frames (audio samples) to analyse. The default of -1 indicates to analyse through end of the buffer

attributes.name: offthreshold
attributes.digest: Off Threshold
attributes.description: The threshold in dB of the envelope follower to trigger an offset. Constraints Minimum: Maximum:

attributes.name: onthreshold
attributes.digest: On Threshold
attributes.description: The threshold in dB of the envelope follower to trigger an onset. Constraints Minimum: Maximum:

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rampdown
attributes.digest: Ramp Down Length
attributes.description: The number of samples the envelope follower will take to reach the next value when falling. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: rampup
attributes.digest: Ramp Up Length
attributes.description: The number of samples the envelope follower will take to reach the next value when rising. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: source
attributes.digest: Source Buffer
attributes.description: The buffer to analyse for gate information. Multichannel buffers will be summed to mono for analysis.

attributes.name: startchan
attributes.digest: Start Channel
attributes.description: For multichannel sources, at which channel to begin the analysis. The default is 0. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: startframe
attributes.digest: Source Offset
attributes.description: Where into begin the analysis (in samples). The default is 0. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: warnings
attributes.digest: Warnings
attributes.description: Enable warnings to be issued whenever a parameter value is constrained (e.g. clipped)

messages.name: bang
messages.description: A bang will commence processing on object given its current settings, unless it is already busy. In that case, the behaviour depends on the value of theattribute.

messages.name: cancel
messages.description: When processing in non-blocking mode, this will cancel the job underway, without updating destination buffers.

messages.name: reset
messages.digest: Return the object to its original state
messages.description: Callingwill change parameter values back to those the object waswith, i.e. any attribute values set in the box will be retained
